text:
This is it, mate!
We’re knocking on the door of the final battle!\c
And we’re up against Raihan and Lee,
of all people...\c
But when we stand together, [VAR 0100(0000)],
we’ve got nothing to be afraid of![VAR 0114(0005)]

So here we are at the final battle.
Took long enough, but we made it, eh?\c
My bro and Raihan ain’t gonna just hand us a
win, though—that’s for sure...\c
But listen. I’ve got your back no matter what,
long as you believe in me, too. All right?[VAR 0114(000D)]
